problem.paragraph: Large companies have security teams and annual pentests. SMEs do not. Scanix makes professional security testing accessible to every business — automated, fast and affordable.

how.title: Three steps to insight
how.step1Text: Enter the address of your website or server. We verify that the system is yours and start the test.
how.step2Text: 15 professional tools run automatically. The same tools real hackers use — now working for your protection.
how.step3Text: Within 10 minutes you get a complete report with a risk score, findings by severity, and a concrete remediation plan. PDF and NIS2 report included.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: One credit equals one complete scan of a single system — a website, server or IP address. You buy credits up front and use them whenever you want.
faq.a2: No. Purchased credits never expire. Use them whenever it suits you, even months later.
faq.a3: Every scan delivers a full report: AI analysis, discovered vulnerabilities with proof, a PDF export, a NIS2 compliance report and the Secure Solution Report with concrete fixes per finding.
faq.q4: Can I scan my own server or website?
faq.a4: Yes. You may only scan systems you own or have explicit permission to test. You confirm this with every scan.
faq.q5: What is the difference between a trial and a paid report?
faq.a5: With the free trial credit you see a limited report without PDF download, without the Secure Solution Report and without advanced modules. A paid package unlocks the full report.

terms.s2Body: It is strictly forbidden to use Scanix to test systems without permission, to carry out attacks, or for any other illegal purpose.
terms.s3Body: Scanix and its developers are not liable for any damage arising from the use of the platform. The user is fully responsible for all actions carried out through the platform.
terms.s4Body: To run scans, you must be able to demonstrate ownership or permission. Scanix reserves the right to block accounts on suspicion of misuse.
terms.s5Body: By using Scanix, you agree to these terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: We only process the data needed to perform a security test: the specified system address, your contact details and the results of the scan.
privacy.s2Body: All your data is stored exclusively on servers within the European Union. Your data never leaves the EU.
privacy.s3Body: Scan results are automatically deleted after 90 days, unless you request otherwise.
privacy.s4Body: You have the right to access, correct and delete your data. To do so, contact us at privacy@scanix.nl.
privacy.s5Body: For questions about privacy, you can contact us at privacy@scanix.nl.

agentPage.title: Scanix Agent
agentPage.subtitle: Scan systems behind your router — without port forwarding or VPN.
agentPage.intro: The Scanix Agent is a small program you run on your own server. It connects to Scanix over secure outbound HTTPS, runs scans locally and sends the results back. This lets you test internal systems that aren t reachable from the internet.
agentPage.benefitText: No firewall rules, no VPN, no open ports. The agent calls out on its own — your network stays closed.
agentPage.benefit2Text: Scans run on your own server with the same tools as our cloud scanner. Only the results leave your network.
agentPage.benefit3Text: The agent runs as a service and updates itself. Install once, done.
agentPage.step1Text: Log in to your dashboard and create a new agent. You get a unique token.
agentPage.step2Text: Run the install command on a Linux server in the network you want to test.
agentPage.step3Text: Once the agent is online, pick it as the scan method and start scans on local systems.
agentPage.tokenNote: Replace YOUR_TOKEN with the token from your dashboard.
